messages:
alice: kicking off probabilistic canary for inference-service v2.3 at 5% -> will ramp to 20% over 30m. tagging @marcos @oncall-sre for watch.

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY START] inference-service v2.3 canary rollout initiated. canary=5%, target=20%, window=30m. CI: green. changelist: feat(cache): new kv invalidation.

marcos: seeing a blip — 5xx rate up from 0.2% -> 1.9% in the last 3m for canary traffic only. sample logs attached: "java.lang.IllegalStateException: cache key mismatch".

oncall-sre: investigating. can you paste the top error stack or a request id? also any OOMs on the nodes?

sara: observability quick look — tail traces show increased tail latency and a cluster of redis MISS spikes coincident with canary requests. looks like new cache invalidation could be causing additional downstream calls.

alice: ok please pause the ramp. issuing pause and pin to stable while we assess. command: `/deploy pause --rollout inference-service --type canary` and `/deploy pin --service inference-service --version v2.2`

deploy-bot: [PAUSE ACK] canary ramp paused at 5%. Current traffic pinned to v2.2 for non-canary -> no further ramp events.

ben: on standby to roll back if we confirm regression. ping me when ready.

marcos: extracting slow request ids: req=abc123, def456. stack shows kv lookup null -> invalidation path triggered. probably config flag flipped in v2.3.

oncall-sre: no node OOMs, CPU fine. toggled circuit-breaker on route /v1/generate to reduce burst retries.

sara: recommendation: rollback canary to v2.2 100% while we revert the cache invalidation change in a patch. If team prefers, we can patch feature flag and re-run canary in the next change window.

alice: we approve rollback to v2.2. ben please execute rollback plan A (fast rollback, keep DB schema).

ben: starting rollback to v2.2 now. ETA ~7m. will comment when deploy-bot reports completion.

deploy-bot: [ROLLBACK START] rolling inference-service -> v2.2 across canary and primary. initiating traffic shift.

deploy-bot: [ROLLBACK COMPLETE] inference-service now at v2.2 (stable) 100% traffic. rollout_id=rl-2024-11-02-1758.

marcos: monitoring: error rate trending back down to baseline. 5xx down to 0.25% in last 5m.

oncall-sre: confirmed no lingering impact. keeping circuit-breaker on for 15m of burn-in.

alice: thanks all. opened a follow-up PR to revert the cache invalidation and add a unit test for the kv key shape. we'll re-run canary in the next maintenance window after a small patch. notes: add more thorough synthetic traffic for cache paths, and include a prefailure test in the rollout checklist.

sara: adding an eval run to Redwood Optimize to quantify token-level latency regressions for v2.3 once patched.

ben: filing a brief deploy note in the release channel and tagging postmortem checklist. cc @oncall-sre to close incident if no further regressions.

alice: closing thread — thanks for quick responses. :tada:
